description:
The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is a prestigious award instituted by the Government of Tamil Nadu. 

It was launched in the year 2018. 

The prize is named after the renowned Tamil poet Kambar. 

Kambar is celebrated for his epic rendition of the Ramayana known as Kamba Ramayanam. 

The primary objective of the Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is to promote Tamil literature. 

It aims to recognize and honor outstanding contributions to Tamil literature. 

The prize specifically focuses on works that reflect the cultural heritage of Tamil Nadu. 

The award is intended to encourage new writers and promote literary excellence. 

It seeks to inspire authors to produce high-quality literary works in Tamil. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is awarded annually. 

The prize amount is set at ₹1 lakh. 

In addition to the cash prize, the award includes a citation. 

The award ceremony is typically held in the month of December. 

The Tamil Nadu Government aims to present the award on Kambar's birthday. 

Kambar's birthday is celebrated on the 15th of Chithirai in the Tamil calendar. 

This usually falls in the month of April or May in the Gregorian calendar. 

The eligibility criteria for the Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize are specific. 

Authors must have published works in the Tamil language. 

The works should be original and not translations. 

Only works published within the last five years are considered. 

The prize is open to all writers irrespective of their age or background. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply. 

The application process for the Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize involves several steps. 

Interested authors must submit their works to the Tamil Nadu Government. 

The submission should include a copy of the published work. 

Authors must also provide a brief biography detailing their literary journey. 

The application must be sent to the Department of Tamil Development. 

The deadline for submissions is typically set for the end of August each year. 

The selection committee reviews the submissions in September. 

The winners are announced in October. 

The award ceremony takes place in December. 

The implementing authority for the Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is the Tamil Nadu Government. 

Specifically, the Department of Tamil Development oversees the award. 

The contact details for the Department of Tamil Development are available on their official website. 

The website provides further information about the prize and the application process. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is part of a broader initiative by the Tamil Nadu Government. 

This initiative aims to promote the Tamil language and literature. 

The government has been actively involved in various literary and cultural activities. 

The prize has garnered significant attention since its inception. 

It has encouraged many authors to contribute to Tamil literature. 

The award not only recognizes established writers but also emerging talents. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize has become a symbol of literary excellence in Tamil Nadu. 

It serves as an inspiration for writers to explore diverse themes in their works. 

The prize is also seen as a means to preserve and promote Tamil culture. 

The Tamil Nadu Government has allocated a budget for the prize each year. 

This ensures the continuity and sustainability of the award. 

The prize has been instrumental in fostering a literary culture in the state. 

It has also contributed to the visibility of Tamil literature on national and international platforms. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize reflects the government's commitment to literature. 

It highlights the importance of recognizing literary contributions in regional languages. 

The prize has received positive feedback from the literary community. 

Many authors have expressed their appreciation for the initiative. 

The award has also sparked discussions about the future of Tamil literature. 

It encourages writers to engage with contemporary issues through their works. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is a significant addition to Tamil Nadu's literary landscape. 

It plays a crucial role in promoting reading and writing in the Tamil language. 

The prize has also led to increased participation in literary festivals. 

Authors are motivated to showcase their works at various literary events. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize has become a prestigious accolade. 

Winning the prize is considered a milestone in a writer's career. 

The award has the potential to elevate the recipient's profile in the literary world. 

It encourages writers to maintain high standards in their literary pursuits. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is a testament to the rich literary heritage of Tamil Nadu. 

It celebrates the contributions of writers who strive to keep the Tamil language vibrant. 

The prize continues to inspire generations of writers in the Tamil community. 

Overall, the Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is a significant welfare scheme. 

It underscores the importance of literature in society. 

The Tamil Nadu Government remains committed to supporting literary initiatives. 

The prize exemplifies the state's dedication to preserving its cultural identity. 

It is a vital step towards promoting regional languages in India. 

The Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize is a beacon of hope for aspiring Tamil writers. 

It encourages them to share their stories and perspectives with the world. 

The prize is a celebration of creativity and literary talent in Tamil Nadu.
